interface.longDescription: A central AMSoft plugin for reviewed agentic workflows. It bundles provenance-backed software delivery; truthful, margin-aware restaurant marketing; business, writing, WordPress, and non-generative food-image workflows; protected DigitalOcean, Cloudflare, Railway, and Excalidraw REST operations; focused single-scene Excalidraw create/update contracts; and authenticated-encrypted configuration transfer.
